## Testing Mode: GREEN

Implement create-story-branch.sh to make T1 tests pass.

## Acceptance Criteria (from DD1)

- Accepts `<epic-id> <story-id>` positional args
- Creates `story/<epic-id>/<story-id>` branch at current HEAD (git checkout -b)
- Idempotent: if branch already exists, succeed without error
- Prints `STORY_BRANCH=story/<epic-id>/<story-id>` to stdout on success
- Exits non-zero with usage on missing args

## Files to create
- plugins/dso/scripts/create-story-branch.sh (executable via chmod +x)

## Notes
- Use `git rev-parse --verify refs/heads/story/<epic>/<story>` to check existence before creating
- ShellCheck clean
- No external dependencies beyond git
